method.record: Member record resolved; all successful direct resolves completed below the production book budget. From resumed validation, resolve uses lookup.readRecord.
method.lookup: HTTP caches cleared before each own-record lookup; createCatalogLookup.lookupBook under production request/deadline/robots/host budgets; no stored answers.
method.scope: Record holdings or provider member-search confirmation required. Shared-cluster matches are not member proof.
method.isbn: Separate cold exact-ISBN probes where source records expose valid ISBNs; these outcomes do not inflate own-record validation.
